title: Mirabai Chanu wins maiden Asian Games medal, bags silver in 49kg category
content: Mirabai Chanu lifted a total of 198 kg in the event. She lifted 87 kg in the snatch before managing 111 kg in the clean and jerk to finish with the silver medal. Chanu had narrowly missed out on a medal at the Hangzhou Asian Games in 2023, finishing fourth after an injury prevented her from completing her final clean and jerk attempt.

title: IIT-Bombay on boil: Professor sent on leave, student's parents 'driven' out of city
content: Sahil Wakode's parents were allegedly taken out of Mumbai against their wishes by unidentified individuals. They plan to start a hunger strike for justice outside IIT-Bombay, demanding prompt arrests. The Mumbai Crime Branch is investigating the circumstances surrounding Sahil's death. Allegations suggest caste-based discrimination contributed to the student's distress before his tragic death. The family expresses their determination for a fair investigation and accountability for those involved.

title: Peacemaker with a warning to annihilate: The major contradictions in Trump's UN speech
content: Trump used much of his address to the General Debate of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly to list his achievements, much as he did a year ago when he cast himself as the standout contender for the Nobel Peace Prize. This year, though, the prize went unmentioned. Instead, his tone hardened, with attacks on the International Criminal Court (ICC), the UN's climate agenda and Unesco.

title: Paid Rs 84,960 for '100% placement guarantee', got no job: MBA graduate wins refund
content: A district consumer commission in Punjab has mandated Eduinx Education Services to refund Rs 84,960 to an MBA graduate. This decision arose after the company was unable to deliver on its promise of guaranteed placement. Harish Malhotra, the complainant, sought compensation due to the company’s failure to fulfill its representation. The commission determined that Eduinx's claims constituted unfair trade practices.

title: Salesforce CEO blames Microsoft for not investing in OpenAI
content: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff says Microsoft's stake in OpenAI stopped his company from investing in the ChatGPT maker. Speaking on Alex Heath's Sources podcast, Benioff said Sam Altman turned him down, pushing Salesforce towards rival Anthropic. That early 2023 bet is reportedly worth about $5 billion, and Benioff believes it could earn Salesforce tens of billions as Claude maker Anthropic prepares for a public listing.

title: Got 2 flats worth Rs 1.38cr for tenancy rights; taxman sent notice, what ITAT said
content: He was a tenant in Mumbai in a housing society that was slated to undergo redevelopment. He received two flats in the redeveloped building in return for surrendering his tenancy rights. The tribunal ruled that a tax demand under Section 56(2)(x) could not be imposed on the individual merely because he received two flats in exchange for giving up his tenancy rights in the redevelopment project.

title: Karnataka man murdered in UAE, body cut into 9 pieces; wife, son untraceable
content: A man from Kundapur, Alwin, was reported missing after last contacting his family in July. His family became suspicious after receiving unusual text messages from his phone, which he rarely used. After his body was discovered in Sharjah, they received a death certificate and filed various complaints. Alwin's wife and son remain uncontactable amid ongoing investigations. Udupi police await official confirmation of the incident from relevant authorities.

title: Nationwide strike : Banks to remain shut for three days - what customers need to know
content: Bank unions are gearing up for a three-day nationwide strike from September 28 to 30, potentially halting banking services and creating a five-day interruption for customers due to the preceding weekend holiday. Key banking activities, including half-yearly closings, will coincide with this period, heightening concerns about accessibility. Customers are encouraged to leverage digital services and finish any in-branch transactions before the strike.

title: Tasmania treated invasive grass; fish species more than doubled in 3 years
content: Tasmania’s Duck Bay wetland is showing signs of recovery after years of work to remove invasive rice grass. Circular Head Landcare has reduced the weed from about 50 hectares to five, allowing native saltmarsh plants to return. University of Tasmania scientists found fish species increased from five to 11, with yellow-eye mullet and other species returning to restored areas.

title: Your AI shopping assistant could empty your account, top banks warn
content: As AI-powered shopping bots continue to gain traction, major banks like NatWest and Bank of America are raising alarms regarding potential risks such as scams, fraud, and breaches of consumer data privacy. A recent report reveals that while consumers are eager to embrace AI shopping, necessary protective measures are lagging.

title: Meet Caymus Maxson, 16, who led 50 beach cleanups and removed 6 tons of debris
content: At 10, Caymus “CO” Maxson saw beach trash being raked towards the sea and decided to act. Six years later, her youth-led nonprofit Trash Turtles has removed over six tons of debris, cleaned 300+ miles of beaches and recycled 75,000 cigarette butts. Now based in California, Maxson has been named a 2026 Gloria Barron Prize winner.

title: 'White House access privilege, not right': DOJ backs Trump barring reporters
content: The Trump administration has claimed the authority to restrict access for journalists to the White House. It argues that access is a privilege and not a right, citing national security concerns. The Justice Department emphasizes that First Amendment rights do not guarantee access to the complex. In response, CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are challenging these restrictions in federal court.

title: Russian oligarch’s wedding gift to Trump Jr puts family dealings under scrutiny
content: Senator John Curtis has called for a thorough Senate investigation into Donald Trump Jr's financial ties to a Russian oligarch amid mounting concerns of potential corruption linked to Umar Kremlev's extravagant wedding celebration. This move seeks to ensure that Trump Jr's foreign business dealings are examined fairly, especially as political dynamics shift ahead of the midterm elections.

title: Operation Sindoor lessons baked in to IAF's multilateral Tarang Shakti wargames
content: The multi-nation air exercise Tarang Shakti will take place at the Indian Air Force base in Jodhpur. Scheduled from September 26 to October 11, the exercise will involve around 40 countries. The Indian Air Force aims to integrate lessons from Operation Sindoor into training scenarios during the drills. This training will include various air operations involving advanced aircraft and combat scenarios.

title: Back home on leave, army man 'beaten to death' by drunk youths in road rage
content: Six individuals were arrested and sent to judicial custody for allegedly killing a soldier from the Assam Regiment. The soldier, Zakaria Lalhriattluanga, was attacked after arriving in Mizoram following his posting in Jammu and Kashmir. This incident occurred near Bualpui village following an altercation over poor road conditions. The accused include both adults and minors, with two minors placed in juvenile custody.

title: Simon Cowell to miss America’s Got Talent finale over health concerns
content: Simon Cowell will not participate in America’s Got Talent Season 21 finale as he recovers from surgery. His absence opens up his spot for YouTuber KSI, who will be a guest judge. KSI will join judges Howie Mandel, Sofia Vergara, and Mel B during the performances and results episode. Simon's health issues led to guest judges filling in while he was away.

title: Gwalior teen raped by 17-year-old neighbour on day of Jamui horror
content: A Class 10 student in Bihar was molested on the same day a Gwalior girl was raped. The Gwalior girl, 16, was approached by her 17-year-old neighbor who blackmailed her with private photos. After forcing her to a flat, he allegedly raped her and later released her. The accused had previously stalked her and threatened her with the morphed images.

title: 'Stalked, hit deliberately': Delhi woman claims bikers chased her scooty before crash
content: A 21-year-old woman reported being stalked and harassed by two men on a motorcycle in South Delhi. While riding home on her scooter, they allegedly hit her vehicle, causing her to fall. The incident resulted in her suffering injuries as she skidded on the road. Police have registered an FIR and initiated an investigation into the matter. CCTV footage reviewed did not reveal the alleged incident or the individuals involved.

title: How 3 men posing as cops turned 17-year-old’s birthday outing into a nightmare
content: A 17-year-old girl from Faridabad was allegedly raped by three men in Aastha Kunj Park. After visiting Kalkaji Temple, she and her male friend entered the park and faced intimidation. The men, posing as police, threatened to inform their parents about their actions. During the incident, the men physically assaulted the girl's friend before taking her to a secluded area.

title: UP man kills wife, 2 priests, takes 3 children hostage; shot dead after 7-hour standoff
content: A police encounter resulted in the death of Arvind Singh after he refused to surrender during a standoff. During the incident, he was holding his three children hostage, leading to a police operation. Arvind had killed his wife and two priests following a dispute concerning a religious ritual at home. His eight-year-old son was also critically injured and later died from his injuries.

title: LSR cancels classes, goes online after Kalkaji Mandir gang rape case
content: Lady Shri Ram College cancelled regular classes and shifted them online after a 17-year-old girl was allegedly gang-raped at Aastha Kunj Park near Kalkaji Mandir. Police said three men, posing as policemen, allegedly separated the girl from her male friend and assaulted her in a secluded area. All three accused have been arrested, while police are investigating the incident and checking for possible links to other cases.

title: 'Almost all agents' data stolen? Hackers claim FBI job site breach, stole 2TB of data
content: The FBI is currently investigating a cyberattack on its job application website, FBIjobs.gov. ShinyHunters claimed to have stolen over 2 terabytes of sensitive data related to FBI employees and applicants. The group alleged they accessed information through a vulnerability in Oracle’s PeopleSoft system. Cybersecurity experts expressed concerns about the potential long-term risks for affected individuals if the data circulates further.

title: How rising house prices have forced Taiwan to settle for ‘haunted homes’
content: In Taiwan, the soaring property prices are leading buyers to consider 'haunted houses,' which come at significantly lower prices due to their grim pasts. Many banks are reluctant to finance these homes, fearing future resale challenges and negative superstitions. Before they move in, buyers often engage in spiritual rituals to honor the spirits, showcasing how traditional beliefs continue to shape the modern housing market in Taiwan.

title: Trump buys up to $50,000 of Musk’s SpaceX, sells some a week later
content: In July, Donald Trump showcased his financial acumen with substantial investments, notably entering and exiting positions in Elon Musk's SpaceX. His trading spectrum also included major players like Microsoft and Amazon, totaling over 1,150 transactions, highlighting a well-rounded investment strategy. Furthermore, he delved into several bond purchases and efficiently maneuvered through exchange-traded funds, demonstrating a proactive approach to managing his financial portfolio amid prior activities.

title: Malayalam actor Vinu Mohan and Vidya divorce
content: Vinu Mohan and Vidya have reportedly divorced after 13 years of marriage, marking the end of their relationship. They had been married since 2013, having met through their connection with the film industry. Vinu has removed pictures of Vidya from his social media account, which has raised speculation among fans. Vidya still retains their pictures on her Instagram, and her account name reflects their previous union.

title: IIT-Bombay suicide case: Student's father threatens hunger strike
content: Sahil Wakode, a second-year BTech student, tragically died by suicide on the IIT-Bombay campus. Following his death, his father, Ravindra, announced a hunger strike if officials involved are not arrested. IIT-Bombay formed a 10-member committee to investigate the circumstances surrounding Wakode's death and put Prof Suryanarayana Doolla on leave. Faculty bodies supported their IIT-B counterparts, while students expressed their demands and concerns on campus.

title: Passport seized, alert issued as cops hunt Kazakh coach accused of raping minor

The coach, Maxat Ayazbayev, is currently untraceable since the complaint was filed last week. Investigations revealed that the assault took place during a training camp at the National Centre of Excellence on September 13. The Cycling Federation of India has suspended Ayazbayev and initiated an internal inquiry into the allegations.

title: Oil prices ease as Saudi restores key pipeline, traders optimistic on US-Iran talks
content: Oil prices have dropped below $100 a barrel due to Saudi Arabia restarting crude supply operations. Diplomatic efforts to resolve the US-Iran conflict have also contributed to easing market pressure. US crude inventories increased by 1.8 million barrels in the past week, contrary to analysts' expectations. Iraq is reportedly increasing its oil exports, signaling a shift in regional supply dynamics.

This purchase signifies Kelce's strong ties to his hometown.

title: Shouldn’t punish for refusing to sing ‘Vande Mataram’: Supreme Court
content: the supreme court agreed to examine the legality of penal consequences if a person does not sing the national song due to religious beliefs or conscientious objection . but declined to adjudicate whether 'Vande Mataram' should comprise two or six stanzas, saying it was best left to Parliament’s wisdom .

title: South Africa mass shooting: At least 11 killed by unidentified gunman in Durban
content:
The shooting took place in the Ziko area of KwaMakhuta, south of Durban.

At least 11 people were killed and three others injured in a mass shooting in South Africa, police said on Wednesday. One of the victims was a woman believed to be pregnant, police said in a statement. The shooting took place late Tuesday night in KwaMakhutha township, around 30 km (19 miles) south of Durban on South Africa’s east coast. According to police, the victims had gathered at a house for a party when three assailants entered and opened fire, the Associated Press reported. Police are searching for the suspects and combing the scene for evidence as the investigation continues. The motive for the shooting is not yet known. More details are awaited.

title: 'Decision unanimous': EC counters report of internal differences over SIR
content: the election commission has rejected reports of differences in the poll panel over the special Intensive Revision (SIR) the poll body clarified that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi did raise concerns over some aspects of voter roll deletion and database handling . the clarification came after an Indian Express report triggered a row by claiming that the two Election commissioners raised objections to the Commission's decisions 14 times during the SIR exercise .

title: India's urban housing story: Over 1 cr homes completed, more families targeted
content: PMAY-U 2.0 aims to support another 1 crore families through its four verticals . the government’s flagship housing programme covers everything from self-construction to affordable housing projects . more than 1 crore houses have been completed and delivered, while 1.25 crore houses were sanctioned as of august 9, 2026 .

title: 97-year-old Brisbane bowls club saved from demolition in $6 million deal
content: the 97-year-old Brisbane institution will remain a place for bowls and community gatherings . the deal preserves both bowling greens and gives the historic club a chance to enter its next chapter without losing the character that has defined it .
